meanings.name: bt_light_elevator_player_pose_cue
meanings.summary: Set by the light elevator actor of scene $E1 239 ticks after the player steps into the elevator tiles; the only readers are the idle, ladder and shimmy-detach branches of player_character, which stage the pose group #10-#13 instead of #00-#03 while it is set.

meanings.name: bt_olman_talk_cue

meanings.name: py_trickle_orbs_a_fallen
meanings.summary: The four falling orbs of the first group of Pyramid scene $D4 (tiles (22,1B), (24,1B), (22,1D), (24,1D), spawn byte #E5) have fallen; at the next load they are drawn already fallen.

effects.set: Each orb of the group takes the fallen state at load (priority minimum, collision cleared) and ends.
effects.clear: Each orb waits for: body bank $97, animation index 1, characterForm 1 (Freedan) and the player within BranchIfPlayerNear #0C; it then sets the flag and falls.

meanings.notes: Dynamic index: flag = $0E word + $80 = (#E5 >> 1) + $80 = $F2 (TestFlagRaw / SetFlagRaw, helper base $00xx). Each orb tests the flag once at load, so within one visit the four orbs of a group fall one by one as the player triggers each. The trigger action (which player move stages body bank $97 animation 1 as Freedan) is not traced: rows 6-8 of body_table use bank $97; attack_ability_system.asm:403 and player_character.asm:610 stage row 6. The shipped header ('energy orbs fall from above in timed patterns') does not match the code. Only scene $D4 places the actor (searched tables/scene_actors.asm for pyD4_falling_orb: rows :4237-:4244, the group rows :4237-:4240 use #E5).
